what: The Hero curtain is locked, so rolling the wheel does not scroll the page. Instead, by the distance rolled (screen height × 1.2, × .53 at 1024px and below), a circular hole at the center of the curtain follows and grows with .35s power2.out, revealing the body below in a circle. When the wheel stops for .3s or on release, if it passed 35% the hole opens beyond the screen diagonal over .25 + .45×remaining s power1.in and the lock releases (fx:open), while a touch that did not get there closes in .4s. ↓·PageDown·Space open it fully at once. Firing fx:lock returns to the top and locks again

options.dist: Wheel distance needed to open fully — fraction of screen height, default 1.2
options.dist-sp: Distance share in windows 1024px and below, default .53
options.release: Threshold to open fully when input stops (0~1), default .35
options.fx:open · fx:lock: Event fired from the element after fully opening · fire it at the element to lock it again (Top link)

from.where: index.html .mc-fv (hero — original: mask radial-gradient(circle var(--hole-size)) on #top, threshold = innerHeight × 1.2(PC)·.53(phone), moveTo .35s power2.out, wheel pause 300ms · past 35% complete .25+(1−shown)×.45s power1.in, unlock when fully open · top Top is lock)

note: Blocking wheel and touch while locked is this part’s job — on phones too, a swipe up on the first screen opens the hole. The blocker covers the full screen height, and it does not lock if the address has a #section or the page is already scrolled down.
